verdict.rationale: Steel is fundamentally API-first: the Sessions API, CAPTCHA/proxy/auth-reuse, human-in-the-loop debug URLs, agent traces, and even the CLI are all documented as thin wrappers over the same REST/OpenAPI surface (steel-docs-1..10, steel-probe-2, steel-probe-3), and the runtime probe confirms the API alone (no UI) can create/list live sessions end-to-end. However, there's no explicit evidence enumerating the dashboard/UI feature set and confirming 1:1 parity with the API — it's inferred rather than directly stated. Missing for 10: an explicit doc/comparison confirming every UI-only feature (e.g. dashboard analytics, trace viewer) is also exposed via API, and independent confirmation of full parity.
